goals.annualGoal: Use a taught calming strategy (deep breathing, movement break, fidget tool, sensory tool, or grounding exercise) to calm her body and re-engage with tasks in 80% of opportunities.

Independently request/initiate a calming strategy when dysregulated (4/5 opps)
Use a strategy and return to assigned task, reflecting on effectiveness (4/5 opps)

goals.annualGoal: Independently answer literal and inferential comprehension questions (or writing prompts) on complex texts at grade-level rubric, from 50% to 75%.
benchmarks: Annotate a given text for the prompt (focus, supporting detail)

Write a claim that accurately answers each part of the question
Find ≥3 effective pieces of textual evidence to support the claim
Write analysis showing how evidence supports the claim

teacherNotes: Frustration → shutdown is the dominant behavior pattern. Pre-empting frustration is more effective than reacting to it.
Jasmine declines offered small-group support in ELA 80% of the time despite needing it. Frame supports as default class structure, not a 'pull-out', to avoid stigma.
Specific positive praise and 1:1 check-ins are highly motivating. Generic praise is not.
Reading level is ~4 grades below text complexity. Texts must be scaffolded (vocab pre-teach, chunked text, graphic organizer) before independent work.
